item.text:
**3B.3 Research Note**

Overall read: I found clear anti-hate / anti-violence rhetoric from Lula in 2024 and only limited counterevidence. The strongest negative material is his Gaza/Holocaust comparison and repeated “genocide” accusation, but that was aimed at Israel’s war conduct, not a domestic campaign against Brazilian opponents, minorities, migrants, journalists, or religious/ethnic groups.

- [Discurso do presidente Lula no evento à margem da Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas “Em defesa da democracia: lutando contra o extremismo”](/https://www.gov.br/g20/pt-br/documentos/discursos/discurso-do-presidente-lula-no-evento-a-margem-da-assembleia-geral-das-nacoes-unidas-em-defesa-da-democracia-lutando-contra-o-extremismo) — Governo do Brasil / G20 — 2024-09-24  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula explicitly condemned racist, xenophobic, misogynistic, and anti-minority narratives, said extremists blame migrants, women, and minorities for current problems, and argued democracy must protect diversity, pluralism, and rights defenders. This is direct evidence against personal incitement of hatred or violence.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.3; also 2B.6

- [Brazil marks anniversary of Jan. 8 attack on democracy](/https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163) — Reuters via Investing.com — 2024-01-08  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula said those who financed, planned, and executed the coup attempt should be “exemplarily punished.” This supports accountability for political violence rather than incitement to revenge or mob action.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.3; also 3B.1, 2B.9

- [Lula repete que governo israelense comete genocídio em Gaza e defende criação de Estado palestino](/https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-02-23  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula doubled down on comparing Israel’s Gaza campaign to genocide and earlier Holocaust imagery. This is the clearest negative item for 3B.3 because it uses highly inflammatory, dehumanizing rhetoric, but it is still directed at a foreign government’s conduct rather than at Brazilian minorities or domestic opponents.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.3; also 2B.9, 2B.10

- [Lula não cita Israel, mas repudia ação em Gaza de novo: 'Queremos paz'](/https://noticias.uol.com.br/internacional/ultimas-noticias/2024/02/29/lula-repudia-acoes-israel-faixa-de-gaza.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-02-29  
  - Claim-level summary: Lula said Brazil wants peace, opposed the Gaza war, and rejected both the Israeli assault and Hamas’s 7 October attack. This is a supportive counterpoint because it shows anti-war framing rather than encouragement of violence against a people or faith group.  
  - Question IDs: 3B.3; also 2B.7, 2B.8

Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of Lula personally inciting hatred or violence against Brazilian opponents, journalists, migrants, civil society, or religious/ethnic groups. The record is mostly anti-extremist / anti-discrimination rhetoric, with the main caveat being his harsh Gaza-related language.
